title: THE WINE THAT BREAKS YOU—OR MAKES YOU NEW
paragraphs: THE WINE THAT BREAKS YOU—OR MAKES YOU NEW

Control it.
Manage it.
Fit it into your life.
And here’s what most people don’t realize…
In Matthew 9:17, Jesus drops a statement that sounds simple—but it cuts deep:

“Neither do people pour new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the skins burst; the wine is spilled out and the wineskins are ruined. But they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”

The problem isn’t the wine.
It’s the container.
Ancient wineskins were made from animal skin—flexible when new, rigid when old.
New wine ferments. It expands. It stretches the container.
So when Jesus says this… He’s not talking about agriculture.
Because this isn’t surface-level teaching. This is identity-level disruption.
You want God to move in your life.
But you’re trying to fit new life into old patterns.

Old mindsets.
Old sins.
Old identity.
You want the presence of God… without the death of self.
But Scripture doesn’t bend to comfort.
“Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.” — 2 Corinthians 5:17
The “old wineskin” isn’t just bad habits.
It’s sin you refuse to release.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
But here’s what most people don’t realize…
God isn’t trying to patch your old life.
He’s trying to replace it entirely.

And if you’ve been trying to hold God in a life that hasn’t surrendered to Him…
this is your moment to stop resisting.
Because the story doesn’t end in breaking.
“For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.” — Romans 6:23
“But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
But grace doesn’t fill old skins.
“I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you…” — Ezekiel 36:26

Because this is just the surface.
and it’s growing almost daily.
So what does this mean for you?
“Why isn’t God moving in my life?”
Because Jesus doesn’t coexist with your old life.
“Repent, and be baptized… for the forgiveness of your sins.” — Acts 2:38
NOW THIS IS WHERE IT TURNS PERSONAL
If this found you… it’s not by accident.
Something is pressing against your life right now.
• FOLLOW the source—because this is only the beginning

And if you’re ready to go all in—
not halfway, not comfortably, not casually—
Because surface-level faith won’t hold what God is about to pour into you.
